data.summary_en: We propose SwarmRSI framework: Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation revises hypotheses and implementations via other agents' experimental feedback; Complementary Swarm Recombination reuses retained hypotheses and complementary program components; Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both into a feedback loop. Achieves SOTA on OpenProblems, NatureBench, and MLE-Bench Lite.
